plan.summary:
The sync no longer visits archived projects.

- `syncAll` in `src/sync/run.ts` skips any project where `project.archived` is true.
- Skipped projects do not call `syncProject` and do not add to the `synced` count.
plan.riskRationale: One guard clause in a loop. The change is small and easy to reason about. Only the diff of one of the two changed files was supplied.
plan.storyArc: One change: archived projects are skipped in the sync loop, so the returned count includes only projects that were synced.

topics.title: Skip archived projects in syncAll
topics.narrativeBrief: What does syncAll do with archived projects now, and how does that change the returned count? Verify that `continue` runs before both `syncProject` and `synced++`. Check what the second changed file contains, because it is not in the hunk index.
